FN-YLSV266-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 102
Committee: Children and Youth Health Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/11/2025
Senate Bill 102 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Medicaid Agency
by an agency-estimated $1 million annually, consisting of $726,300 in federal funds and
$273,700 in state funds, by providing certain prenatal coverage to women found presumptively
eligible by a qualified provider.
Further, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the agency to adopt rules and
develop forms for use by qualified providers to determine presumptive eligibility.

FN-YLSV266-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 102
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/05/2025
Senate Bill 102 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Alabama Medicaid
Agency by an agency-estimated $1 million annually for fiscal years 2026, 2027, and 2028,
consisting of $726,300 in federal funds and $273,700 in state funds, by providing certain
prenatal coverage to women found presumptively eligible by a qualified provider.
Further, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the agency to adopt rules and
develop forms for use by qualified providers to determine presumptive eligibility.
